title: [CQ-M07q] Strict WORKING and REVIEW claims require the VM route
description:
Slice of CQ-M07 (task-1a8f1d0e199046a289e94a5453d758b8). Design: mem:decision-cq-m07-verified-local-activation. Epic rail: no unsupported isolation downgrade; a caller field may refuse, never grant.

Objective: a verified-local (strict) task is never handed to a seat that would run its agent CLI on the host, for example an older wrapper or a hand-run CLI. The wrapper's VM route (CQ-M07m/n) marks its claims; an unmarked strict WORKING or REVIEW claim is refused. Readiness stays assertExecutionProfileReady's alone.

Deliverable: claim_next_task (packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/claimNextTask.ts and the claim-eligibility path it uses) gains an optional `executionRoute: 'vm'` argument in its inputSchema.
- For a task whose resolveTaskExecutionProfile(settings, task.executionPolicySnapshot) is verified-local, a WORKING or REVIEW claim without the marker is refused on an explicit taskId claim and skipped by the ranked pool and moe.wait_for_task, with one fixed code (e.g. EXECUTION_ROUTE_REQUIRED) and a message that says a VM-route seat must claim it.
- PLANNING claims (architects stay on the host) and every claim of a legacy/observe task are unchanged, with or without the marker.
- Any other executionRoute value is INVALID_INPUT. The marker never satisfies readiness.

NOT in scope: the wrappers sending the marker (CQ-M07m/n); readiness; docs (CQ-M07 sweep).

Verification: the FULL daemon vitest suite (shared tool) in a git-archive snapshot with this task's files overlaid: cd <snapshot>/packages/moe-daemon && npm ci && npm test, under env -i with the nvm Node 24 PATH. Never in the shared checkout.
definitionOfDone: With readiness mocked ready (mem:convention-verified-local-test-fixture), a strict WORKING claim and a strict REVIEW claim with executionRoute 'vm' succeed; without it an explicit taskId claim is refused with the fixed code and the ranked pool skips the row (vitest through the tool).
PLANNING claims of strict tasks, and every claim of legacy or observe tasks, behave exactly as before with or without the marker (vitest).
With the default not-ready snapshot, a strict claim carrying the marker is still refused EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY (vitest).
An executionRoute other than 'vm' is refused INVALID_INPUT (vitest).
The full daemon suite passes in a git-archive snapshot; the completion cites the counts.
taskRails: Put new test rows in a new test file: packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/claimNextTask.test.ts, state/validators.ts and types/schema.ts are declared by WT-19 (task-b1ca54f2), which is still open.
The marker may only refuse; never let it grant readiness or skip any other claim check.
